correctness.rationale: For an \(r\)-space \(U\), a nonzero simplex column vanishes on the whole subcode exactly when it lies in \(U^\perp\), so the simplex contribution is always \(q^m-q^{m-r}\). The identity contribution is the coordinate support size \(s(U)\), whose minimum is \(r\). Inclusion-exclusion over coordinate hyperplanes gives the exact multiplicity formula. Direct RREF enumeration independently matches every histogram for \((q,m)=(2,3),(2,4),(3,2),(3,3)\).

value.rationale: The source introduces infinite LCD-optimal families and emphasizes their complete ordinary weight distributions. Generalized Hamming weights are the natural higher-dimensional refinement of minimum distance, with established uses in wiretap and secret-sharing analysis. The result determines every generalized weight for both new families and, more strongly, counts every possible subcode support size in closed form. This turns a one-dimensional weight description into a complete higher-support profile across all dimensions.
